description: Submit a stage-aware review decision on a completed Open Label task — the same pipeline as the employer review queue (stage progression, reject-reason validation, prevent-own-review, evidence, pay-on-accept settlement). Decisions: ACCEPT, FIX_ACCEPT, REJECT, REWORK. A non-final accept advances the task to the next review stage; the final stage's accept finalizes it. Requires open-label:write scope.

note.description: Optional review note (shared with annotators on reject/rework).

rejectReasonCode.description: Reason code from the project's reject-reason taxonomy (may be required by stage config).

name: open_label_submit_review
